request.style: English, piano ballad, warm gentle male vocal, piano, strings, soft acoustic guitar, swelling drums in the final chorus, calm and reassuring, 68 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
Peter stepped out on the water when the Master told him come
But when he saw how strong the wind was, he was afraid
And beginning to sink he cried out, Lord, save me
At once Jesus reached out his hand and caught hold of him

[Verse]
I have lain awake at midnight with a weight upon my chest
Counting every what-if, finding no place for my rest
But a voice cuts through the dark like a lantern on the shore
And it speaks the word to me that it spoke so long before

[Chorus]
Do not fear, for I am with you
Do not be dismayed, for I am your God
I will strengthen you, I will surely help you
I will uphold you with my righteous right hand

[Bridge]
For God did not give us a spirit of timidity
But of power and love and self-control
There is no fear in love
Perfect love drives out fear

[Chorus]
Do not fear, for I am with you
Do not be dismayed, for I am your God
I will strengthen you, I will surely help you
I will uphold you with my righteous right hand

[Outro]
Peace I leave with you; my peace I give to you
Do not let your hearts be troubled, and do not be afraid
